description: Find-and-replace dialog for the rich text editor, hosted on the core TmModal (browser top layer, role=dialog, Escape, focus trap; focus returns to the saved editor selection). Anchored to the top of the viewport and immune to overlay clicks. The Replace/Replace All callbacks return the REAL replacement count from tmRichEditor.findAndReplace, which the result line reports (0 renders a localized 'no matches' message). Enter in a field submits the form and runs Replace (single) — never Replace All. Known limitation: matches are per text node; text split across inline formatting (e.g. foobar) is not matched.

parameters.name: OnReplace
parameters.description: Replaces the first occurrence. Must return the real number of replacements made (from tmRichEditor.findAndReplace) so the dialog can report the true outcome — including 'no matches' for 0.

parameters.name: OnReplaceAll
parameters.description: Replaces every occurrence. Must return the real number of replacements made (from tmRichEditor.findAndReplace) so the dialog can report the true outcome — including 'no matches' for 0.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTargetId
parameters.description: The id of the element focus returns to when the dialog closes — the host editor's content surface, so the saved caret/selection can be replayed.
